notes.title: Anima: Gate of Memories I & II Remaster – An Action-RPG Saga Reforged
notes.content:
This release rebuilds [b]Gate of Memories[/b] and [b]The Nameless Chronicles[/b] from the ground up, with enhanced visuals, rebalanced combat, and gameplay improvements on a single new title. Whether you're a longtime fan or discovering Gaia for the first time, this is the ultimate way to experience the saga.

Prepare to (re)discover the world of Gaia, the way it's meant to be experienced!

Coming later this year!

WISHLIST NOW!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3592140/Anima_Gate_of_Memories_I__II_Remastered/?

[b]UPDATE CHANGES[/b]
Also, along with the announcement, we have done several general bug-fixing of the current version of Anima, to make the game more stable and improve performance.

notes.title: Patch 1.02 Released
notes.content:
PATCH NOTES 1.02
-Fixed a bug that caused an unexpected crash of the game.
-Fixed a bug in which the rotation of the projectiles depended on the framerate.
-Fixed a bug in the texts of Velez Shop after having bought all the available items.
-Fixed a bug that allowed you to get off the stage by climbing the wall of a cave.
-Minor corrections of some texts in Spanish.
